_comment: SAFETY hook: block deploy-shaped Bash commands (exit 2 = deny the tool call). Ports the reference system's deploy guard, generalized: add your project's own deploy entry points to the pattern. The bootstrap merges this into the project's .claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); sys.exit(2 if re.search(r'deploy_to_production|terraform\\s+apply|cdk\\s+deploy', c) else 0)"
